name: BPT Empty Output Detection & Fix
author: QualityEvaluator (Claude本人)
pre_context: When evaluating BPT training reports, check if the output contains actual metrics (loss, accuracy, epoch, GPU utilization) or if it's just a placeholder. BPTtrain has a known failure mode: producing '- Training status:' with nothing after it. This is E503: Empty output.
inspection_steps: 1. Read the agent output — is there actual data or just a placeholder?
2. If output < 20 chars → E503: Empty output (score 0.5/5)
3. If output has <!--thinking--> but < 50c content → E501: Thin output
4. Check if the same output has appeared 3+ times → STUCK detection
5. Suggest: check AI config, upgrade to tooled agent, or downgrade capabilities

remediation.immediate: Mark agent output as E503. Flag agent for review.
remediation.long_term: Check API key validity. Upgrade agent to tooled or remove training_monitor capability.
